Downfall of London Road Medical Centre!
I am writing this review with a heavy heart and a strong sense of disappointment regarding my experiences at London Road Medical Centre. The level of care, or lack thereof, has become so abysmal that I feel it's my duty to warn others.
The most frustrating issue is the utter impossibility of getting an appointment. The receptionists, who seem to have mastered the art of being unhelpful, act as gatekeepers, making it clear that they do not want to help you. The clear lack of empathy and a genuine desire to help is disheartening.
